episode_summary: In this episode, Carrie McCormick discusses the evolving landscape of luxury real estate, emphasizing the importance of lifestyle optimization for high-end clients. She also highlights the role of AI in personal branding and digital presence, offering strategies for standing out in a competitive market. Additionally, Carrie shares insights on building strong relationships and navigating multiple offers effectively.
